units.source_text: “这么说，日本与中国的业余棋手水平大致相同啰？

en.t: So does that mean the level of amateur go players in Japan and China is roughly the same?

units.source_text: 也就是说，倘若中国像日本那样培养专业棋手，中国人也会具备这种素质啰？”

en.t: In other words, if China trained professional go players the way Japan does, Chinese players would also have that kind of aptitude, wouldn’t they?
